subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v3 07/11] mountd: give each worker its own netlink command socket

2026-09-14.patch_summary: This patch addresses a problem where multiple workers in the mountd process share the same netlink command socket, leading to incorrect sequence checks and potential data corruption. To fix this, each worker is given its own netlink command socket by reopening the inherited sockets in the child processes. This ensures that each worker has its own reply stream and prevents two workers from taking each other's acknowledgments or error messages during a round trip.
